_: NEW-5 — the PANEL-BREVITY budgets. See /CLAUDE.md → PANEL-BREVITY for the rule.
Set at the measured value with ZERO headroom, deliberately: adding a visible sentence to any
of these surfaces turns CI red, so the accumulation has to be a decision instead of a drift.
To get back under budget, COLLAPSE — move the sentence into the group's 'Assumptions & method'
disclosure (keyedNote), into a title=/basis= hover, or inside a <Collapse>. All three are
budget-exempt because all three keep the fact reachable. DELETING a fact to fit is forbidden.
Raising a number here is allowed but never silent: it requires a line on the BACKLOG item
saying which sentence was added, why it must be visible by default, and what was removed.
Baseline history (jsx regions, total): 171 lines / 14728 chars before NEW-2's consolidation;
156 / 13002 after — a net reduction even though NEW-4 added the flood-level sensitivity ladder.

Justification, per the rule:

yet carry Colorado detention criteria.' / the regime-less variant. This is the single most
important line in the Colorado work and it CANNOT be collapsed: the owner's constraint is

37-92-602(8)).' A statutory failure — detention that drains too slowly is an out-of-priority
diversion in a prior-appropriation state. A failed legal test is not a method note.

and unknown) are keyedNote, i.e. budget-exempt; and ALL of the substance — both statutory
tests, the rebuttable presumption, the post-2015 State Engineer notification, the optimism
caveat, the governing regime's criteria manual, and the WQCV+EURV explanation of WHY the
Texas engine cannot answer — rides the notes' info argument, which is exempt.

Texas copy it sits beside: a Colorado site shows the Colorado line and never the rate badge,
the band note or the outfall note, and a Texas site never renders any of these. The static
audit counts every literal in the file, so the budget grows even though the DEFAULT VIEW OF
ANY GIVEN SITE does not grow by a single line. That is the honest reading of this raise.
